summary: fix(pairing): remove Cancel from desktop pairing timeout screen
description:
Because:

- Cancel on the timeout screen sent users to the sign-in page, though
  they are already signed in on that computer.

This commit:

- Renders only "Try again" for the timeout variant; canceled still
  offers "Sync settings".
- Drops the onCancel prop, its container handler, and the Cancel FTL
  string.
- Updates tests, mocks, and stories to match.

Fixes FXA-14463
